name: Ultracare Penetrating Plus Stone, Tile and Grout Sealer
description: UltraCare Penetrating Plus Stone, Tile and Grout Sealer is a water based penetrating sealer for interior and exterior natural stone, unglazed ceramic tile, masonry, cement pavers, concrete, brick and cement grout. It soaks in instead of filming over, so unlike an intensifier it does not alter the appearance of the surface, and Mapei lists it as salt and alkali resistant. The coverage decides the order, not the area: one 3.79 litre jug does 130 m2 on a tight surface and only 18.6 m2 on an absorbent one, so density, porosity and texture are what a quantity has to be taken from. Protection against most common stains is stated for up to 15 years. Apply between 10 and 26 degrees C on a dry surface, let new grout cure 48 hours first, and buff off every trace that has not been absorbed.
meta_description: UltraCare Penetrating Plus Stone, Tile and Grout Sealer: water based sealer, 18.6 to 130 m2 per 3.79 L jug. TDS download from Lapiz Blue, Dubai UAE.

specs.pack_size: Bottle 473 mL (1 U.S. pint), bottle 946 mL (1 U.S. qt.), jug 3.79 L (1 U.S. gal.)
specs.voc_content: less than 100 g per L to SCAQMD Rule 1113, typical content 7 g per L by SCAQMD Rule 1113 testing methods
specs.duration_of_protection: expected to protect against most common stains for up to 15 years
specs.industry_standards: Meets all EPA and SCAQMD standards for VOCs
specs.storage_temperature: 40°F to 90°F (4°C to 32°C), do not allow to freeze
specs.storage_shelf_life: Up to 2 years when stored in the original sealed container

applications: Sealing interior and exterior natural stone: marble, granite, limestone, sandstone, slate, Saltillo and travertine
Sealing some unglazed porcelain tile, masonry surfaces, cement pavers, quarry tiles, concrete and bricks
Sealing cement grout, once a new grout installation has cured for at least 48 hours
Use as a pre grouting sealer before the grout goes in
Resealing a surface that has started to absorb water in the drop test
notes: Not the Emirates edition. Mapei publishes no UAE sheet for this product, so the record is built from the Mapei Corporation North America sheet, English Canada, edition date May 4 2026, MK 3000213 (26-1448). Pack sizes, coverage and temperatures on that sheet are US customary with metric in brackets, and the jug it prints as 1 U.S. gal. (3.79 L) is the 3.785 l line we stock. Safety data sheet version 6 dated 24 September 2025, first edition 18 May 2017.
